headline: Show Me the Results
thesis: From Washington's edtech letter to Educause's No. 1 priority, the pressure is on to prove AI and edtech actually work.
summary: EdSurge revisits the Department of Education's guidance urging districts to buy technology on learning outcomes, not usage, and its podcast on the "October Blues" looks at teacher burnout. Inside Higher Ed reports on Educause's 2027 Top 10, where AI value tops the list for the first time, and on Instructure data showing little AI tool uptake. THE Journal covers surveys on network trust and specialized infrastructure as AI bottlenecks, and EdTech Magazine looks at planning infrastructure for CTE programs. Ahead: EdTech Week (NYC, Oct 12-16) and the 1EdTech Technical Congress (Oct 19-21).
footnote: Compiled from 11 curated edtech sources · October 8, 2026 · Items come from search-indexed results rather than direct site fetches; most sources had no new dated news today and list recent or evergreen items. EdTech Week dates vary by listing.
